purpose: Represent a deterministic planner decomposition unit without creating scheduling, claim, CURRENT or promotion authority.
truth_boundary: atomic_task_v1 is planning evidence only. A unit becomes executable only after the existing Guide successor semantic-dedup gate materializes an existing portfolio-derived job and the normal portfolio PIN/claim grants ownership.

coarse_job_detection.objective_test: A split is justified only when at least two proposed units can be independently resumed, verified, retried or assigned without inventing new authority, and the saved parallelism/recovery/isolation value exceeds the extra claim+context+return overhead.

atomic_task_v1.owner_rule: Name an existing durable role/project owner such as GUIDE_PLANNER, GUIDE_CRITIC, portfolio project_id or verifier role. Never bind a worker_id before normal claim authority exists.
atomic_task_v1.consumer_rule: Name the existing downstream role/job/artifact that can consume the output; no consumer means the unit is not materializable.
atomic_task_v1.dependency_rule: Dependencies contain atomic_task_id values from the same decomposition only when a hard data/authority dependency exists; ordering preference alone is not a dependency.
atomic_task_v1.capability_rule: Copy only capabilities actually required by the unit, allowing central allocator capability pressure to route it later.
atomic_task_v1.recovery_rule: Checkpoint names the smallest durable evidence needed for a fresh shell to continue without chat recap.
atomic_task_v1.authority_rule: Use PLANNING_ONLY_NO_CLAIM_AUTHORITY until semantic dedup + derived-job materialization + normal PIN claim occur.

determinism.canonicalization: Trim scalar strings, sort/dedupe string arrays bytewise, serialize JSON with the canonical_identity_keys order, SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes, and use the first 12 lowercase hex chars.
determinism.ordering: Topologically sort by hard dependencies, then phase, then atomic_task_id bytewise.

materialization.rule: For each materializable atom, build the existing semantic identity root/target/problem/acceptance, CREATE the existing successor fingerprint pin, and only the pin winner may CREATE the derived portfolio job. The atom itself grants no execution authority.

portfolio_mapping.evidence: input_refs + parent job ref + atom contract ref

single_worker_fallback.rule: When extra capacity is absent, one claimed Guide/worker shell may execute ready atoms sequentially in deterministic order, preserving the same atomic_task_v1 inputs/outputs/checkpoints. This changes execution concurrency, not the contract or authority model.
single_worker_fallback.forbidden: Do not mint fake sub-worker ownership or skip normal authority when an atom is materialized as a separate portfolio job.

examples.why_coarse: The job combines planner-contract design, Guide/Metabolism integration, deterministic regression and compatibility verification. The harness can be implemented/verified independently after contract inputs are frozen.
Source-fixture integrity and representative-browser behavior are separate gates. A corrupted immutable fixture should fail a source atom without consuming the browser atom's setup budget.

Room bootstrap/backend reachability is an upstream gate distinct from paired-client command/state verification. Isolating it makes a PGRST/backend failure recoverable without rerunning the entire command matrix.
